answer: We formulate a mechanism combining dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices to deter Sybil attacks. Agents harbor incentives to participate truthfully, as multiplying identities on the mesa of strategic interaction yields strictly negative expected payoffs due to imposed bonds and penalties. Under this trellis of punishment, any deviation triggers severe consequences, ensuring convergence to a strict Nash equilibrium wherein agents truthfully report their types, thereby guaranteeing Sybil resistance in the adversarial multi-agent environment.
